sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- building destroyed] A Russian airstrike destroyed the Kramatorsk City Council executive committee building on Peace Square, central Kramatorsk, on Oct 31. Honcharenko: "An hour ago, Russia destroyed the central building of Ukrainian statehood in Kramatorsk with an airstrike." The building had survived the 2014 occupation/liberation and was previously damaged in a March 2026 airstrike. [UNVERIFIED] Casualties from this strike were not immediately available; other Oct 31 Kramatorsk attacks injured civilians per Suspilne (no count given in the item read).
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct publisher families: Kramatorsk City Military Administration (primary source) + Suspilne (T2, Ukrainian public broadcaster). EuropeSays is the conduit read and has no declared tier in the registry.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian confirmation or denial located in-window; casualty status explicitly unavailable at publication.
sections.why_matters: Symbolic-administration strike in Donetsk: the building that survived 2014 is gone. No casualty count, no proven-lane warning element -- monitor, do not lead.
